constraints.notes: Portrait orientation (width > height). Both dimensions must be multiples of 32.
Total frames must be (8 * n) + 1 for LTX Video.

sampling.notes: I2V optimal CFG is lower than T2V (3-5). Distilled models require 15-20 steps.

conditioning.notes: Placeholder for image-to-video. The conditioning image is used as the first frame.

prompts.positive: A cinematic portrait of a person, photorealistic, soft lighting, subtle camera movement, natural skin texture, expressive eyes, gentle smile, shallow depth of field, high detail, 8k, professional photography style
prompts.negative: deformed, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts, unnatural motion, distorted face, extra limbs, bad anatomy, worst quality, watermark, text

optimization.notes: FP8 reduces VRAM to ~28GB on RTX 4090. CPU offload may increase latency. VAE tiling only for high-resolution inputs.
